_what: B12 PILOT VERDICT. Both authorised cells (rung P + control Dctl) measured 2026-08-17 on LOCAL (sm_100/wzc1). 0.61 GPU-h wall.
VERDICT: KILL, and NOT the kill the proposal was hoping to rule out. Two pre-registered clauses fire, and clause_5 REFRAMES clause_4: the finding is about the OPERATOR, not about SLoRB's rank being over-provisioned.

clause_4_KILL_ON_PILOT.text: If PILOT rung P scores < 60.64, the cheapest step on the measured frontier has already failed and no deeper rung can succeed. STOP; do NOT launch Q/R/S.
clause_4_KILL_ON_PILOT.consequence: Q/R/S remain UNAUTHORISED and must not be launched.

clause_5_KILL_ON_CONTROL.text: If the density-matched SVD control Dctl scores >= rung P, the verdict is 'basis coarsening is the wrong operator', NOT 'SLoRB is over-provisioned'.
clause_5_KILL_ON_CONTROL.consequence: This is the load-bearing clause. Because the control BEATS the treatment at matched density (0.08% apart in live params), the pilot does NOT license any statement about how much rank SLoRB needs. What failed is block-basis coarsening as an operator, at this one density, on this one checkpoint.

THE_MARGIN_IS_INSIDE_THE_NOISE_FLOOR.why_this_matters: clause_5 is written as a bare inequality (>=) and it IS satisfied. But +0.8184 pp is BELOW the 0.8953 pp noise floor the proposal itself measured, so the direction is real per the pre-registered rule while the MAGNITUDE is not resolvable at n=1. State the clause as triggered; do NOT additionally claim SVD is measurably better by 0.82 pp. Reporting only the clause and hiding the floor comparison would overstate it.
THE_MARGIN_IS_INSIDE_THE_NOISE_FLOOR.recorded_by: MAIN, unprompted -- the clause would have read as a clean win without this line.

clause_3_INDETERMINATE_also_applies_to_P.note: The emitter's own row says INDETERMINATE for P: 2.3801 pp is 1-2 CI widths at n=1. So even the clause_4 failure is 'failed to clear the bar', not 'measurably worse by 2.38 pp'.

what_this_does_NOT_establish: NOT 'SLoRB rank is over-provisioned' -- clause_5 explicitly forbids that reading when the control wins.
NOT 'SLoRB rank is necessary' either. Only ONE density was tested (55.03%), by ONE operator family, post hoc.
NOT a training-time rank ablation. Post-hoc surgery on a checkpoint trained at SLoRB_k=16; a model TRAINED at lower k could reallocate capacity and land anywhere.
NOT a 2:4 result. Both cells are FOLDED and dense on disk (verify_2of4 rc=2, zero_frac 0.000000 on every sampled tensor).
